definition.en: The International Development Association (IDA) is a member of the World Bank Group that provides concessional loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries.
definition.hi: The International Development Association (IDA) is a member of the World Bank Group that provides concessional loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the IDA is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it highlights the role of international financial institutions in global poverty reduction and infrastructure development. It provides insights into how external funding impacts the Indian economy and the broader framework of international development finance.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding the IDA is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it highlights the role of international financial institutions in global poverty reduction and infrastructure development. It provides insights into how external funding impacts the Indian economy and the broader framework of international development finance.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the operational mechanism of IDA and its concessional lending model.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the operational mechanism of IDA and its concessional lending model.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of IDA funding on socio-economic development in developing nations.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the impact of IDA funding on socio-economic development in developing nations.
